Welcome to
the Seven Oral Care community -
a world where oral care is oral beauty.

settings.text: “A smile is your best accessory”. We’ve all heard this old adage countless times but somewhere along the way it seems to have been forgotten. Forgotten by the existing players in the oral care segment who continue to churn out the same old boring and/or gimmicky products. Forgotten by you, the user, for whom oral care doesn’t even feature as a form of self-care anymore. That’s where we come in.

Hi! We’re Dr. Namrata (a passionate dentist) and Tanvi (a passionate brusher) who have come together to create the much-needed explosion in the tired (read:boring) oral care industry.

Here’s our promise – honest oral care products. From visualisation, to development to testing to launch – every product is painstakingly created first and foremost by Dr. Nam. So we’re not “dentist approved” or “dentist backed”. We are dentist created. And hence we will never launch a product that is not beneficial to you.

With the science bit locked in, the next challenge is – how can we make oral care fun? We found that it all comes down to the experience. Thus, our mission – to create products with game-changing features and drool-worthy design. Be aesthetically pleasing and have the best functionality – for you. 

You, our user, are the “why” to our “what”- you are at the centre of everything we do. We’re two female first-time entrepreneurs and we’re here to listen. We would love for you to drop in your suggestions, feedback, ideas or just connect with us on wecare@sevenoralcare.com.

Are you ready to discover the difference?

Love,
